task_description: ACIP Phase 4 (REACT rewrite): (1) a React SPA demo UI in a self-contained top-level ui/ directory (Vite + TypeScript + React 18, pinned deps, npm with committed package-lock.json, Vitest + React Testing Library, ESLint + Prettier) that is a THIN presentation layer over the EXISTING checkout-api HTTP endpoints — five scenario buttons mirroring scripts/demo.py bodies, a free-form new-checkout form, a colored decision banner (green APPROVE / amber CHALLENGE / red DECLINE) with composite_score/route/alternatives/recommended_method/explanation, six agent-verdict cards fetched+polled from GET /v1/transactions/{id} (tolerate empty/partial), a recent-transactions session list with /explain click-through, and loading/error states; plus the ONLY backend change it needs: additive CORSMiddleware on checkout-api (CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS, default '*') with a CORS test; plus a multi-stage ui/Dockerfile (node:20-alpine build -> nginx:alpine serving on port 80 with SPA history fallback, build-time VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL default http://localhost:8080) wired into docker-compose as demo-ui publishing NEW host port 8090:80; and (2) a LOCAL run mode that runs the 14 app services as host uvicorn processes (distinct ports via the --port CLI arg; infra still in Docker via make up-infra) and the React UI via the Vite dev server on 5173, through start-local.sh/stop-local.sh + Makefile up-local/down-local + a committed .env.local.example, WITHOUT changing the all-Docker path. The WRONG prior htmx/FastAPI demo-ui attempt has been reverted. Stay on feat/phase1-foundation; do not branch/reset/rebase/amend/force-push; do not modify docs/01-07 (may update README.md + docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md); both deliverables are purely additive apart from the CORS middleware.
